text:
alex: heads-up — seeing a repeated latency oscillation on llama3-13b after the kernel-selector tweak. 95th spikes ~120ms -> ~600ms every ~90s for sessions using short chat templates (system prompt ~50 tokens).

alex: attached perf snippet from a repro run (local staging):
```
# timeline (ms) per request:
0. 110
1. 130
2. 115
3. 630  <-- spike
4. 120
5. 135
6. 125
7. 610  <-- spike

# stacksample (simple):
service::serve_request -> kernel_selector::select -> kernels::fused_attn_small_heads -> kv_cache::evict_check -> cuda_memcopy
```

mira: hmm. frequency suggests some periodic cache/eviction path. are these chat sessions with short prefixes so KV cache never really warms?

alex: yeah short prefixes + lots of short-turn chat (2-3 user messages) — prefix length distribution skewed low. Also noticed selector logs choose the "fused_attn_small_heads" kernel during spikes, other times it picks "batched_prefetch" variant.

dan: can you paste the selector debug output around a spike? curious about rope_theta estimates and head dim path.

alex: here, snippet from selector log (trimmed):
```
[selector] req=12345 seq_len=12 prefix=48 heads=32 head_dim=64 rope_theta=1000 selected_kernel=fused_attn_small_heads reason=low_seq_est
[selector] req=12346 seq_len=8 prefix=50 heads=32 head_dim=64 rope_theta=1000 selected_kernel=batched_prefetch reason=batchable
```

sam: rope_theta=1000 looks high for this model? iirc our default for llama3-13b we scaled rope_theta down in last model-profile PR (to 700) but maybe this instance still has prior metadata.

mira: important detail: our kernel cost model uses estimated kv-cache reuse to pick kernels. with short prefixes and chattemplate padding, the reuse predictor flips every few requests — that could oscillate kernel choice and thrash soft-allocs on GPU.

dan: plausible. also if selected kernel path uses different memory layout (head-major vs kv-major) we can get intermittent cudaMemcpy spikes.

alex: repro plan I ran: force rope_theta=700 in selector config and run 1k requests -> spikes went away in staging.

alex: quick command I used to force test: `curl -X POST $SEL/debug/override -d '{"rope_theta":700}'` and then a small load test.

sam: good find. could be two orthogonal problems: (1) stale model metadata causing rope defaults mismatch, (2) reuse predictor threshold too sensitive for chat templates.

mira: suggest short-term mitigation: add a sticky kernel binding for chat sessions with prefix_len < 60 for 30s. prevents flip-flop. medium-term: update metadata ingestion to prefer model-profile rope_theta override and smooth the reuse predictor with hysteresis.

ops-bot: deploy queued: kernel-selector/2026-03-18/hysteresis-patch -> canary in 3 mins

dan: action items:
- alex: open perf repro PR with comparison traces + config to force rope_theta (include the pre/post p99 numbers).
- mira: implement sticky-binding PoC for chattemplate short-prefix case.
- sam: audit model-profile ingestion for Llama2/3 to ensure rope_theta head_dim/kv_dim consistency.

alex: will attach the raw perf traces and the small load script in the PR. p99 went from 620ms -> 130ms after forcing rope_theta fix in staging.

mira: thanks. also add a unit test that simulates short-prefix churn to avoid regressions.

sam: ping me once PRs are up, I'll coordinate Dedicated fleet canary if ops-bot shows green. :thumbsup:
